subject: CPPB Domain III: Sourcing & Supplier Selection

questions.q: An incumbent vendor requests a 6% price increase upon contract renewal, citing rising raw material costs. To conduct an objective price analysis to determine if this increase is fair, the buyer should compare the request against the:
options: Producer Price Index (PPI) or Consumer Price Index (CPI)
questions.explain: The Producer Price Index (PPI) measures the average change over time in the selling prices received by domestic producers for their output, making it the standard tool for verifying inflation-based price increase requests.
